name: Otter AI
one_liner: Otter.ai AI meeting assistant for transcription, summaries and action items; has an Enterprise-gated Public API (beta) and an official read-only MCP server.
auth_notes: Public API: Bearer API key created in workspace Developer settings (max 2 per user). MCP server (mcp.otter.ai/mcp): OAuth 2.1 with per-meeting permissions. Details are from a third-party source because help.otter.ai is Cloudflare-blocked to the fetcher.
access_notes: Public API reportedly available to Enterprise workspaces only (Enterprise is contact sales). Official pricing lists the Otter MCP server as a feature of the free Basic plan. Official help articles were not fetchable.

buildability.rationale: A public API (beta) exists at api.otter.ai/v1 but is gated to Enterprise workspaces. Official MCP server is read-only (3 tools, OAuth). Evidence for gating is third-party.

needs_human_reason: help.otter.ai articles (Public API beta, MCP server) are behind Cloudflare and could not be fetched; Enterprise gating comes from a Scalekit blog.

disputes.why: Otter's official llms.txt links this Public API (beta) article.
Third-party analysis: API uses Bearer API keys, MCP uses OAuth.
Public API reportedly Enterprise-only; Enterprise is contact sales.
Otter's own llms.txt links an official MCP Server article and pricing lists Otter MCP server; hosted at mcp.otter.ai.
Public API exists but Enterprise-gated; product identity resolved (otter.ai, not OtterlyAI).

identity.quote: Otter.ai is an AI meeting assistant and meeting agent platform for real-time transcription, automated notes and summaries
